<execute-bead>
  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260512T144832-56b4d484/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260512T144832-56b4d484/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260512T144832-56b4d484/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260512T144832-56b4d484/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260512T144832-56b4d484/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-c6c8bc9e">
    <title>service: rename Profile→Policy public surface + drop ModelRef + new error types + target scrub</title>
    <description>
PROBLEM
  Public service surface (service*.go, routing_errors.go, internal/serviceimpl, internal/core) exposes Profile naming, ModelRef fields, ResolveProfile/ProfileAliases methods, and a sprawling FizeauService interface (17 methods). The v0.11 surface trims this to ~14 methods, renames Profile→Policy, drops ModelRef entirely, and removes target-language from comments/error strings.

ROOT CAUSE
  Public surface predates v0.11. Profile/ModelRef were the canonical inputs; ResolveProfile returned per-surface preview data tied to the dropped Surface concept. Target language is sprinkled through service_models.go and other files as legacy of the dropped target abstraction.

DESIGN INTENT (v0.11)
  - FizeauService interface methods: rename ListProfiles→ListPolicies; drop ResolveProfile and ProfileAliases entirely.
  - Types: ProfileInfo→PolicyInfo (no AliasOf field, no Target field); drop ResolvedProfile, ProfileSurface entirely.
  - Request fields: Profile→Policy on RouteRequest and ServiceExecuteRequest. Add AllowLocal bool, Require []string. Drop ModelRef from RouteRequest, ServiceExecuteRequest, and ResolvedModelRef field. Keep MinPower/MaxPower as soft signals.
  - RouteDecision.RequestedProfile→RequestedPolicy. RoutePowerPolicy{Profile, MinPower, MaxPower}→RoutePowerPolicy{PolicyName, MinPower, MaxPower}.
  - Public errors: ErrProfilePinConflict/ErrNoProfileCandidate/ErrUnknownProfile→ErrPolicyRequirementUnsatisfied + ErrUnknownPolicy + ErrUnsatisfiablePin (mirroring Phase 1 routing errors).
  - HarnessInfo: drop IsLocal/IsSubscription bools, replace with Billing modelcatalog.BillingModel.
  - ProviderInfo: add IncludeByDefault bool, Billing modelcatalog.BillingModel.
  - ModelInfo: add Billing modelcatalog.BillingModel; drop CatalogRef field.
  - Scrub all routing-context "target" language from production code (comments, error strings, helper function names like catalogRefForModel). Add scoped lint rule preventing reintroduction in service_*.go, internal/routing/, internal/modelcatalog/.

CURRENT STATE WITH FILE:LINE
  - service.go:22-43 FizeauService interface (17 methods)
  - service.go:228-249 HarnessInfo (IsLocal/IsSubscription)
  - service.go:260-313 ProviderInfo, ModelInfo
  - service.go:321-360 ProfileInfo, ResolvedProfile, ProfileSurface
  - service.go:368-404 RouteRequest (Profile, ModelRef, MinPower/MaxPower fields)
  - service.go:441-484 RouteDecision, RoutePowerPolicy
  - service.go:676-796 ServiceExecuteRequest (Profile, ModelRef, ResolvedModelRef, MinPower/MaxPower)
  - service_profiles.go (~190 lines, rename to service_policies.go and rewrite)
  - service_routing.go (59+ Profile/ModelRef hits)
  - service_models.go:491,559 catalogRefForModel + target-level pricing comments
  - service_session_log.go:79-80,130-131 RequestedModelRef/ResolvedModelRef field assignments
  - service_override.go:108 ModelRef field assignment
  - routing_errors.go:170-251 ErrProfilePinConflict, ErrNoProfileCandidate, ErrUnknownProfile

PROPOSED FIX
  1. service.go: rename interface methods (ListProfiles→ListPolicies; drop ResolveProfile, ProfileAliases). Replace ProfileInfo/ResolvedProfile/ProfileSurface with PolicyInfo. Update all request/response types (RouteRequest, RouteDecision, RoutePowerPolicy, ServiceExecuteRequest, HarnessInfo, ProviderInfo, ModelInfo) per design intent.
  2. Rename service_profiles.go → service_policies.go. Rewrite: implement ListPolicies returning []PolicyInfo from cat.Policies(). Drop everything else.
  3. service_routing.go: rename req.Profile→req.Policy; drop ModelRef reads; map cat.Policy(req.Policy) → routing.Request{Policy, AllowLocal, Require, MinPower, MaxPower}; rewrite escalateProfileLadder→escalatePolicyLadder; rewrite serviceRoutingReasoningResolver to query cat.LookupModel(modelID).ReasoningDefault directly (no surfaces).
  4. service_models.go: drop catalogRefForModel function (dead after ModelRef removal); rewrite cost fallback to use cat.LookupModel(modelID).CostInputPerMTok directly (no PricingFor target-level lookup).
  5. service_session_log.go: drop RequestedModelRef/ResolvedModelRef field assignments.
  6. service_override.go: drop ModelRef passthrough.
  7. routing_errors.go: replace public error types per design intent. Rename ErrNoLiveProvider.StartingTier→StartingPolicy.
  8. Scrub target-language: comments referring to "target" in routing context → "policy" or "model"; HealthTarget stays (different concept).
  9. Add scoped lint: new file internal/lint/targetlint/analyzer.go (modeled on DDx's routinglint) that flags identifiers and comments containing "target" in routing context inside service_*.go, internal/routing/, internal/modelcatalog/.
  10. Update all service_*_test.go inline YAML fixtures and struct field references (~25 files).

NON-SCOPE
  - Internal core (internal/core/) — Phase 7.
  - CLI flags — Phase 6.
  - Provider config (user-config) — Phase 5.
  - DDx coordination — Phase 9.

PARENT + DEPS
  Depends on Phases 1, 2, 3.
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. service.go FizeauService interface has exactly the v0.11 method set: ListPolicies replaces ListProfiles; ResolveProfile and ProfileAliases are removed.
2. service_policies_test.go::TestListPoliciesReturnsCanonicalEntries passes (returns the four canonical policies with their fields).
3. service_routing_errors_test.go::TestErrPolicyRequirementUnsatisfiedShape passes (typed error includes Policy, Requirement, AttemptedPin fields).
4. service_routing_test.go inline-YAML fixtures all use v5 schema; tests pass.
5. service_routing_test.go::TestServiceTranslatesPolicyAirGappedToRequireNoRemote passes (req.Policy="air-gapped" → routing.Request.Require=["no_remote"]).
6. service_session_log_test.go: no test asserts presence of requested_model_ref or resolved_model_ref fields in session events.
7. internal/lint/targetlint/analyzer_test.go::TestFlagsTargetInRoutingContext passes (analyzer flags `target := req.Policy` in service_routing.go style code).
8. grep -rn "Profile\b\|ModelRef" service.go service_*.go (excluding _test.go files) returns only sampling-profile and stdlib `errors.Is(target error)` matches.
9. grep -rn "ResolveProfile\|ProfileAliases\|ProfileInfo\|ResolvedProfile\|ProfileSurface" --include="*.go" returns zero hits in non-test production code.
10. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go vet ./... clean.
11. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go build ./... succeeds.
12. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go test ./... -count=1 green.
13. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
    </acceptance>
    <notes>
Closed parent after child chain plus final service-routing vocabulary cleanup in d98a0125. Verification: service.go interface inspected and has 14 v0.11 methods with ListPolicies and no ResolveProfile/ProfileAliases; go test . -run "TestListPoliciesReturnsCanonicalEntries|TestErrPolicyRequirementUnsatisfiedShape|TestServiceTranslatesPolicyAirGappedToRequireNoRemote" -count=1; go test ./internal/lint/targetlint -run TestFlagsTargetInRoutingContext -count=1; grep -rnE "Profile\b|ModelRef" service.go service_*.go --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" returned zero matches; production rg for ResolveProfile/ProfileAliases/ProfileInfo/ResolvedProfile/ProfileSurface returned zero matches outside archived/generated skill and benchmark artifacts; grep -rn "target" service.go service_*.go internal/routing internal/modelcatalog --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" returned only HealthTarget and stdlib errors.Is target parameter matches; rg requested_model_ref/resolved_model_ref in service session-log files returned zero matches; go vet ./...; go build ./...; go test ./... -count=1; lefthook run pre-commit --all-files. Internal core/session ModelRef fields remain for the phase 7 non-scope.

Review 2026-05-12: parent cannot remain closed while public routing still accepts legacy policy aliases.
    </notes>
